warnings.issue: Earthen materials (Adobe, Rammed Earth) lack specific density and moisture content bounds in the dataset. Source citations are generic.
System relies on synthetic/fallback weather models (weather_2026.csv) rather than verified TMY3/EPW historical files.
Floating point truncation on manually entered expected R-values causes strict 10^-4 tolerance checks to fail.
Structural bearing capacities and seismic loads are not evaluated. Claims of 'code compliance' are limited to thermal/geometric bounds.
